Read one FragPipe psm.tsv or DIA-NN report.tsv file

Source: R/loaders-fragpipe.R
read_fragpipe.Rd

Reads a single search-engine tsv with readr::read_tsv() (optionally truncated to the first ~100 rows for fast iteration via testmode), and tags every row with samplename. Shared internally by both the FragPipe and DIA-NN batch readers — the two formats only diverge once the per-sample frames are parsed into pep_all shape.

Usage

read_fragpipe(folder, samplename, testmode = FALSE)

Arguments

folder

Path to the tsv file to read.

samplename

Sample identifier to record in the new Sample_fp column (derived from the file's parent folder name by the batch reader).

testmode

Logical; if TRUE, reads only the first ~100 rows for fast iteration (can break downstream correlation plots on tiny subsets).

Value

The tsv contents as a data frame, with Sample_fp added and relocated to the first column.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
read_fragpipe("2_data/fragpipe_dda_combined/JY/psm.tsv", "JY", testmode = FALSE)
} # }
